summary: Upscales input video with NVIDIA Maxine Video Effects using faster upscale modes or higher-quality super-resolution modes.

key_params.name: strength
key_params.note: Enhancement amount for Upscale Filter modes.

key_params.name: artifactreduction
key_params.note: Reduce artifacts for lossy-compressed input in Super Resolution modes.

common_gotchas: Official docs mark NVIDIA Upscaler TOP as Windows-only.
Requires a 20, 30, 40, or 50 series NVIDIA RTX card.
Models must be downloaded separately through the NVIDIA Video Effects SDK resources for the target GPU.
Cannot be used in the same project as ZED because of TensorRT version conflicts.
Fractional upscale modes require source dimensions divisible by 2 or 3 depending on the mode.
key_concepts: Upscales input video with NVIDIA Maxine Video Effects models.
Provides faster Upscale Filter modes and higher-quality Super Resolution modes.
Strength applies to Upscale Filter modes; Artifact Reduction applies to Super Resolution modes.
Each mode has documented input-size and divisibility requirements.
